summary: THE ROUND-GRAIN MAP IS NOW A PAGE-GRAIN MAP: 25 anchors for rows 12 and 18-41, every one on two independent lineages, plus the four A14 nulls filled and three ENDs repaired. THE HEADLINE STRUCTURAL FINDING, because it changes how the stored data should be read: animefillerguide's chapter column for this series is record-of-ragnarok.fandom's `adapted=` chapter set with the page splits stripped — identical on all 42 rows, including the unusual ones (ep 17 '29, 30, 32, 33'; ep 18 '31, 34'; ep 33 '64, 65, 66') and on all twelve S1 rows. The twenty stored afg-tier anchors are therefore a mechanical re-derivation of ONE editorship, never an independent witness, and this verdict cites AFG nowhere. It does check them: of the twenty afg endpoints in the ask, NINETEEN are confirmed exactly on the pages and ONE is refuted — ep 19's START, which the stored row gives as 34 and the pages give as 32 (the episode opens on ch 32 p.1, Shiva's wives and the salt ritual; ch 34's three pages sit in its middle, and A13 says a row displays its FIRST chapter). THE FOUR A14 NULLS ARE FILLED FROM THE PAGES: ep 22 = 43 [41] {41, 42, 43 (pp.1-15, 22-43)} v11 — the END repairs 42 -> 43, because the episode plays 37 of ch 43's 43 pages and ends on its LAST page (Buddha taking the Gjallarhorn and declaring for mankind), while ep 23 owns only a six-page MIDDLE slice (pp.16-21, the Jack/Göll tea scene), so A47's tail clause cannot reach it; ep 27 = 54 [52] {52, 53, 54, 55 (pp.21-23)} v14 — END CONFIRMED, the ch-55 share really is a three-page tease and A47 holds it back; ep 33 = 66 [64] {64, 65, 66 (pp.1-9, 27-32)} v16 — the END repairs 65 -> 66, because the episode plays 15 of ch 66's 32 pages including its last page, out of order (Hermes' requiem before the vault door), a shape en-WP's summary independently narrates; ep 38 = 77 [76] {76 (pp.8-46), 77} v19 — END CONFIRMED, ch 77 adapted whole to the Tartarus coda. EP 12 IS REPAIRED IN THREE FIELDS: START 1 -> 19 (a nine-episode phantom back-reach; the episode opens at ch 19 p.19, the page ep 11 stops on), chapters_adapted -> '19 (pp.19-69), 20 (pp.1-16, 32-52)', and END 19 -> 20 — the S1 finale plays 37 of ch 20's 52 pages to the chapter's last page (Heimdall introducing Jack and Heracles), so the stored 'ch 20 partial as R4 cold-open' is position language, not a five-page scrap. Volume 5 stands. THE INSTRUMENT WAS TESTED, NOT ASSUMED. The page-closure check the ask names was run on every straddled chapter: thirteen close exactly (chs 19, 20, 29, 32, 33, 34, 43, 45, 55, 66, 73 by count, 79, and 36 conditionally), five are off by exactly one page at the chapter's last page (59, 71, 73, 76, 83 — clamped here and named on each row), and TWO have real gaps. The verifier's ch-36 finding is CONFIRMED — six pages (pp.35-40) are claimed by no row, reported and not smoothed — and a second gap at ch 49 pp.23-26 turns out to have a cause the wiki itself records: 'Beelzebub debut and his laboratory scenes were removed and delayed', i.e. they are ep 26's cold open, now a `rearranged` annotation. SECOND LINEAGES: programming-cafe's anicomi 対応表 (per-episode AND per-chapter) carries eps 12 and 18-27, but it has NO season-3 data at all — its per-chapter table stops at ch 56 with '↓ここから先はアニメ未放送' — so eps 28-41 rest on en-Wikipedia's per-episode summaries read against the fandom's per-CHAPTER summaries, plus ja-WP's episode titles, eleven of which are the namesake title of a chapter inside the row's own span. Volumes needed a third lineage because programming-cafe's 単行本 column runs one volume behind from v12 to v19; MangaDex's aggregate matches the fandom exactly (v12 = 46-49, v16 = 62-66, v21 = 83-86, the last being the stored boundary), so the two contested volumes (ch 49 -> v12 on ep 25, ch 66 -> v16 on ep 33) go the fandom/MangaDex way. TEN ANNOTATIONS record what the numbers cannot: four un-cross-cuts (chs 31-36 across eps 17-19, ch 43 across 22/23, ch 49 across 25/26, ch 66 across 33/34) and the eps 27/28/29 recap cluster, in which ch 55's 34 pages are split 21-23 (ep 27's tease) / 1-18 (ep 28's only first-time content) / 19-34 (ep 29) and the overlaps are exactly the re-shown material. ELEVEN CONTINUES: the four healer-written 'anime jumps back' values on 21 / 26 / 32 / 37 all disappear — those seams are ordinary END + 1 parities once the finale STARTs are real (21 -> 41, 26 -> 52, 32 -> 64, 37 -> 76). The ONE genuine back-jump continue in the run is ep 18 -> 32, delivered under C2 with a C3 skip note, on the d-gray-man precedent. NO TYPE CHANGES: all 25 rows are CONFIRMED AS STORED canon, including ep 28, whose recap frame is weightless under T28's recap clause and whose remainder (ch 55 pp.1-18) is pure source. No anchor_hostile row: every row in the ask carries a position.
